react.policy: Re-check the latest patched React 19.2 release before installation and keep react and react-dom identical.

routing.pattern: stable parent tree plus patchRoutesOnNavigation deferred children

builderKernel.note: B3a fixed a latent B0 defect: dispatch now appends log/history BEFORE store.write (uSES snapshots are checked synchronously inside the notification) — 003 contract §15.

builderView.entrypointLaw: apps import ONLY @craftkit/builder (BUILDER_FAMILY_ACCESS is CI-fatal); layer-2 siblings never import each other — the renderer takes the kernel by prop
builderView.registrySnapshot: kernel-intrinsic extensions.version() read via useSyncExternalStore (never listener-derived)
builderView.theming: CSS custom properties --t-*; blocks use logical properties only

builderShell.scope: B2a read-only canvas + B2b drag editing + B3a editing surface: schema-generated Inspector (zero panel code per block; guarded one-dispatch commits; structural group labeling; per-def lazy field-type cache with containment and R8 focus lock), default field library (draft discipline: external writes always win), DeviceBar + bucketForWidth (768/1024 half-open, drafts commit on blur/Enter only), EditorCanvas frameWidth+breakpoint (frame shell shares origin with overlay), PreviewMode (publish-safe path, zero-tx round trip, modal-surface Escape, view-state dir override).
builderShell.performanceLaw: merge gates count (0 content re-renders, observer-attributed updates); wall-clock budgets belong to uncontended evidence runs only
builderShell.chromeTheming: shell-owned --bldr-* custom properties with inline fallbacks, independent of the document --t-* theme

builderRichText.containment: BUILDER_CONTAINED_DEPENDENCY validator rule (all sections + npm aliases + the workspace ROOT manifest) plus a discovery-derived import-specifier graph test
builderRichText.readPath: zero-dependency RichText renderer — canvas, preview, and static output never load the engine

reviewerProfile.fallback: fail-closed when Codex, the selected model, or fresh non-empty review evidence is unavailable
reviewerProfile.runtimeEnforcement: packaged launcher passes sandbox=read-only, approval-policy=never, and ephemeral session flags directly to Codex

deliveryOrchestration.coordinator: initiating integration; Codex by project default
deliveryOrchestration.worker: native Codex workers for Codex runs; observable read-only Codex workers through the async project adapter when Claude coordinates; synchronous fallback only for authorized writes

routingPolicy.codexInitiated: stay in Codex; never invoke Claude unless the current user explicitly requests Claude
routingPolicy.claudeInitiated: Claude may call Codex through the project bridge for bounded approved work
routingPolicy.purpose: avoid agent ping-pong and duplicated context while retaining one-way load distribution

asyncReadOnly.transport: stdio Node wrapper over codex exec --json --ephemeral
asyncReadOnly.smokeTest: one real start-status-result task returned the expected README heading; SHA-256 of tracked binary diff plus Git-visible untracked paths, modes, and contents matched before and after
asyncReadOnly.safety: read-only and never-approve; user config and plugins disabled; core-only shell environment; repository-contained cwd; bounded in-memory state; POSIX process-group cleanup; Windows fails closed
asyncReadOnly.progress: status reads local state with 30-55 second coalescing and starts no additional Codex call

synchronousWriteFallback.use: explicitly authorized implementation until the official plugin or an approval-capable async transport is installed

projectAdapters.preferredReplacement: official Codex plugin for Claude Code backed by the Codex app server

deliveryOrchestration.delegationGate: run-local delegation.json is initialized pending and engine-validated; required accepts only delegated work with an accepted result
deliveryOrchestration.reviewLane: fresh ephemeral Codex process with engine-enforced read-only and never-approve flags plus a 29-minute internal deadline below the workflow timeout, never the implementation worker thread

integrationStatus.explanation: plan, tasks, and implement are intentionally wrapped by the installed preset for each of three integrations; verify the preset registry before forcing an integration upgrade
integrationStatus.extensionSkillSync: workspace@1.4.1 is generated for the default Codex integration; Claude and Cursor regeneration is pending explicit permission because Spec Kit 1.0.1 requires temporarily changing the default integration

specKit.scopeModel: root governance plus scoped feature directories; member projects only for independent governance or release needs

one relevant docs page when architecture, setup, testing, or operations is in scope
